discussion.body:
User lock, Act 13 last image.
Cael sadly accepts the office the world calls God of Life. That office is God of Death. Liraen becomes the new Goddess of Life. They stay together and separate: mirrors of each other's offices, not a shared throne and not a household cutscene. No kiss. No marriage. Both live.
Predecessor God of Life is Vortan (FEAT-049), spoken as "Vorath" in the ask. Do not mint Vorath.
Still one ending (FEAT-037). Plug/seal thesis is not deleted: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, Asteria scarred and standing. The succession sits on top of that as the last frame.
Open on this ticket: last-fight body. Current lock is Nyxara (FEAT-050), Vortan is not the Act 13 last fight. User line is "after defeating Vortan." Do not silently drop Nyxara. Confirm next pass whether Vortan is a phase, an Act 12 mid-fight, or the last body.
Local design: asteria-cast/storyline/act-13-ending.md. No app source from this pass.
